benefits.text:
BBIA Ready To Wear Water Lipstick is a glossy tint lipstick with a lightweight water-glow texture that helps lips look fresh, soft and naturally plump. The lipstick glides smoothly over the lips, creating a clear layer of color that can be worn every day without making the overall makeup look heavy. The color goes on light in the first layer and can be layered to build intensity, suiting many makeup styles from natural and feminine to bright seasonal looks.
1. Soft, smooth water lipstick texture that glides lightly and gives a moist, smooth feel on the lips.
2. Clear tint color, easy to adjust from light to deep and layerable without getting thick.
3. A light glow effect helps lips look plump, radiant and more lively.

With a palette of 5 easy-to-wear shades such as Wet Mandarine, Wet Rose, Wet Camellia, Wet Apricot and Wet Plum, BBIA Ready To Wear Water Lipstick suits those who want a convenient lipstick that still has a soft glossy tint effect. The product can be worn alone for a natural lip color, or layered for more shine and color depth in fresher makeup looks.

howToUse.text: Apply a layer of lip balm before use to help avoid dryness and darkening of the lips.

safety.text:
For external use on the lip area only; do not use on damaged lips,
Stop use if any unusual signs appear and keep out of reach of children.
